narr: A cold front moved through the region in early May, bringing isolated severe thunderstorms and flooding.
ev: Multiple streets were flooded in North Lake Charles and Moss Bluff.
Heavy rain flooded streets in Moss Bluff, Gillis, and DeQuincy. Multiple stream gages also indicated ditches and creeks in the area flooded.
